rules.action: Freeze deployments and follow the incident runbook.

rules.condition: > 1% for 10 minutes and at least 20 requests
rules.action: Identify the failing route and deployment SHA; roll back when correlated with a release.
Pause launch promotion, verify Supabase availability, and reconcile affected orders.
Treat as a payment-integrity incident and investigate before manually changing any order.
Check callback configuration and source traffic; do not disable signature verification.
Inspect lookup, verification, and database-update duration fields.
Do not promote the deployment until the failed check is understood and resolved.
